subject: CloudSentry pricing: packaging fit vs EdgeScale and migration credits
messages:
From: Procurement <procurement@cloudsentry.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-01T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: RFP follow-up & ask: pricing / credits for vendor swap

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the quick demo last week. We're collecting side-by-side pricing for a potential move from EdgeScale and I wanted to confirm a few things before we share internally:

- Do you have a compact term sheet that outlines reserved capacity pricing tiers, onboarding credits, and standard enterprise discounts?
- Any precedent for migration / egress credits for customers switching mid-contract?
- We have strict requirements for a VPC/private deployment option for our EU workloads — please flag any additional costs.

I've attached our RFP and current usage profile for context (CloudSentry_RFP_2026.pdf). We're aiming to present a recommendation to our procurement committee the week of 3/15.

Appreciate any quick pointers.

Best,
Asha Mendel
Head of Procurement, CloudSentry
procurement@cloudsentry.io

(attachment: CloudSentry_RFP_2026.pdf)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Procurement <procurement@cloudsentry.io>
Date: 2026-03-01T10:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RFP follow-up & ask: pricing / credits for vendor swap

Hi Asha — thanks for the RFP. I'll pull together a concise term sheet and a migration playbook for you. A couple quick asks to tailor the proposal:

- Can you confirm 12- vs 24-month preferred term?
- Typical token/embedding monthly volume and 95th percentile latency SLO target for inference (we can model Dedicated vs Hosted).
- Any existing contract language re: termination fees from EdgeScale?

Looping in Rishi (AE) and Marcus (Solutions) to draft the commercial and technical attachments. Expect a first-pass term sheet by 3/5.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
(attachment: none)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-03-03T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: CloudSentry RFP — initial commercial thoughts

Kimberly / Marcus — quick internal: I reviewed Asha's RFP. My initial proposal to be competitive vs EdgeScale:

- Year 1: 20% list discount on Hosted API + $75k onboarding credit (applied to first 3 invoices)
- Reserved capacity option: price lock for 12 months at negotiated throughput; additional 10% discount on reserved MSRP if they commit to Dedicated for critical workloads
- Migration/egress credit: up to $50k depending on contract overlap (cap to be validated with finance)
- Support: 6 months premium support included for free (EdgeScale offered premium for 6 months in their quote)

Attaching a draft pricing_model_v1.xlsx to calibrate variables. We should also offer a small proof-of-value pilot with limited cap on tokens to reduce their risk.

Thoughts? If we want to be more aggressive, we can tilt onboarding credit up and move discount to 25% for Year 1, but that needs approval.

-Rishi
(attachment: pricing_model_v1.xlsx)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-04T11:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: CloudSentry RFP — initial commercial thoughts

Agree with Rishi's construct but want to call out technical packaging / potential cost levers in the term sheet: 

- Offer: Hybrid package — Hosted API for burst and low-latency endpoints, Dedicated pools for steady high-throughput jobs (helps us win on unit cost).
- Quantization profiles and batching recommendations can reduce token cost ~12–18% for their workload mix — include as an appendix.
- SLA: 99.9% with automatic fallback to certified open model variants if primary model capacity constrained.

I'll draft an appendix on deployment topology and estimated token economics to include with the term sheet.

-Marcus

(attachment: none)

From: Procurement <procurement@cloudsentry.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonathan P. <jonathan@edgescale.ai>
Date: 2026-03-06T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RFP follow-up & ask: pricing / credits for vendor swap

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks — quick update from our side. EdgeScale has provided a competing term sheet that includes: 30% off list for Year 1, 6 months complimentary premium support, and a migration credit equal to 3 months of committed spend. They also offered a phased onboarding credit of $100k.

We like Redwood's technical approach, but commercials are the gating factor for procurement. Can you close the gap on the Year 1 discount or expand the migration credit? Also, we have a firm EU VPC requirement that cannot incur additional per-region fees.

Forwarding EdgeScale's summary below for reference:

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Procurement <procurement@cloudsentry.io>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-09T17:22:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood term sheet and migration offer — CloudSentry

Hi Asha — thanks for sharing EdgeScale's summary and the timeline. We want to be competitive and keep the focus on long-term unit economics and reliability. Here's what Redwood can offer today: 

Proposal (concise):
- Year 1 commercial: 25% off list on Hosted API and Managed Embeddings + $75k onboarding credit (applied across first 4 invoices)
- Reserved/Dedicated option: additional 8% discount on reserved MSRP with 12-month price lock
- Migration credit: up to $75k (evidence-based; requires copy of EdgeScale contract clause for overlap validation)
- Support: 6 months premium support included at no cost
- EU VPC: available at no additional per-region fee; we will provide SOC2 evidence and deployment checklist in the appendix
- Proof-of-value: 6-week pilot capped at their current monthly token baseline; onboarding support included

We are prepared to put this in a formal term sheet and DocuSign envelope for signature; please review the highlights and let me know if you need any modifications. If this addresses commercial alignment we can finalize legal language and send the term sheet by 3/11.

Link to term sheet & signature: https://www.docusign.com/embedded-signature/abc12345

Best regards,
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
(attachment: Redwood_CloudSentry_Term_Sheet_20260309.pdf)
